code:
entryPoints:
  web:
    address: ':80'
    http:
      redirections:
        entryPoint:
          to: websecure
          scheme: https
  websecure:
    address: ':443'

certificatesResolvers:
  le:
    acme:
      email: {{email}}
      storage: /letsencrypt/acme.json
      httpChallenge:
        entryPoint: web

providers:
  docker:
    exposedByDefault: false
summary_zh: traefik 靜態 config,web 自動轉 https + LE
